title: Gymdesk vs Zen Planner: Prices, Website & Apps (2026)
description: Gymdesk vs Zen Planner for dojos, gyms and studios: published starting prices, active-member pricing, website and app add-ons, contracts.
body:
Both Gymdesk and Zen Planner price by active members and don't charge for staff or prospects. Gymdesk publishes every tier up to 250 members; Zen Planner publishes only its "starting at" prices.

{{table:gymdesk,zen-planner}}

Pricing

Gymdesk: $75/$100/$150/$200 per month for up to 50/100/150/250 active members with Gymdesk Payments, or $100/$125/$175/$240 with your own processor. Zen Planner: Studio starts at $99/mo, Essentials (Studio plus website) is $198/mo and Ultimate (plus Engage marketing) is $348/mo. Zen Planner says pricing scales with active members but doesn't publish the tiers.

Website

Gymdesk includes a gym website on every plan. Zen Planner's website starts at $99/mo on its own, or comes in the $198/mo Essentials bundle.

Apps and hardware

Zen Planner includes staff and member mobile apps; a branded app and card readers are $39/mo each. Gymdesk's branded member app is $100/mo (first month free), and door access is $100/mo for up to 3 doors.

Extra features

Zen Planner lists staff payroll, belt and skill tracking, and a SugarWOD integration, plus a dedicated onboarding specialist and done-for-you data migration. Gymdesk lists per-program rank progression, kiosk/barcode check-in and self-serve data export with no exit fee.

Contracts and trials

Gymdesk: month to month, 30-day trial, no card. Zen Planner: month to month (annual on request); we didn't find a free trial on its pricing page. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}} {{aff:zenplanner|Visit Zen Planner}}

faq: Is Gymdesk cheaper than Zen Planner?

At entry level, yes: Gymdesk is $75/mo with Gymdesk Payments (up to 50 members) vs Zen Planner Studio from $99/mo. Zen Planner doesn't publish its higher member tiers, so we can't compare larger gyms exactly.
Does Zen Planner include a website?
Not in Studio. The website starts at $99/mo, or comes bundled in Essentials at $198/mo. Gymdesk includes a website on every plan.
Who counts as an active member?
Zen Planner counts anyone with a membership or who attended an event in the past month. Gymdesk excludes visitors, frozen or cancelled members and prospects.
Both are month to month. Zen Planner offers an annual contract on request.
